Purposeful Use of Evidence in Argument Writing

Micro-Credential

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This micro-credential recognizes your ability to guide students in selecting and integrating evidence effectively to craft strong, nuanced arguments. Beyond teaching students to cite sources correctly, this approach encourages deliberate decision-making about which evidence to include and how to engage with it meaningfully. By introducing Harris Moves, you help students join the academic conversation rather than merely supporting a claim.

Criteria

  • Share strategies you have used to help students choose quality evidence for their writing.

  • Work through the Harris Moves and experiment with Forwarding and Countering techniques.

  • Reflect on how these strategies can help students move beyond basic citation and toward more engaged, thoughtful argument writing.
